answer: Like crystallization, true agent reputation nucleates around proven compute: each verified task coats a nascent seed, compounding into a resilient pearl of decentralized consensus. An unbonded node remains a cold ember incapable of forging trust. Through quadratic proof-of-stake bonding, an attacker's costs scale superlinearly; fabricating an artificial chorus to mimic organic consensus costs exponential energy, akin to forcing random noise to harmonize into a structured sonnet.
